candidate_artifact.candidate_scope: repository-pinned application/config replay component carried as durable evidence across recurring Chat invocations

observations: The pinned primary-source file explicitly sets DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER to groq and declares API-key/config surfaces for Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini.
The same file also declares external-service configuration surfaces for Supabase, Redis, Pinecone, Jina, Cloudinary, Replicate, Hugging Face, Pollinations and LangSmith.

The file provides application/config identity such as APP_VERSION, model names, sqlite default DATABASE_URL and .env file locations/encoding, but does not declare Python/interpreter version or build, dependency versions or lock digest, OS/architecture identity, container/runtime image digest, resolver/index snapshot, or actual environment values.
The file alone does not prove that any configured external provider is actually invoked at runtime, so this audit does not broaden potential dependency into a claim of observed execution.

verdict.reason: The candidate accurately packages a pinned config surface through durable repository transport, but the primary source exposes multiple external-provider/credential surfaces and omits execution-environment identity. Actual provider use is untested, so external execution/quota dependence cannot be asserted as present; equally, its absence, quota-zero operation, user-secret independence and zero-cost full-route behavior are not established. This component therefore cannot close a dependency-elimination row.

scope_guard: This verdict applies only to scientist_agents p1-sa-403 and the pinned config.py body. It does not assess dependencies.py, dependency manifests/locks, transitive resolution, runtime calls, provider account terms, other files, or another candidate.
